requirement: A store sees last month's searches on Laria as counts by city
expected: Lo que buscan en Laria shows brands, typed searches, categories and types, searches without results and alerts for the last Lima month, with active publications and the store's own
preconditions: Store reach migrations applied; a built report
steps: Open Mi tienda → Lo que buscan en Laria; pick a city

requirement: No figure under 5 people is stored or shown
expected: Rows under 5 are never written; totals under 5 show "menos de 5"; the check constraint refuses lower values
preconditions: Report built from a fixture with 4-person searches

requirement: The report never keeps who searched
expected: No report row holds an account, session or event id; e-mails, phones and document numbers typed in the search box are dropped
preconditions: Searches with an e-mail, a phone and a DNI

requirement: The report states its limits and gives no advice
expected: Qué no te dice este reporte is open above the tables with its six limits; the intro says the figures are counts, not recommendations; no row is labelled as an opportunity

requirement: Store and Admin searches are not counted
expected: A store owner's search of their own brand does not change the count

requirement: Only active stores and Admin can read the report
expected: A Particular, a pending store and a signed-out visitor get an error; Admin can read it

requirement: The daily job builds last month once and keeps 13 months
expected: Running the job twice builds one report; reports older than 13 months are deleted

requirement: A store turns its feed on and gets one address for Meta
expected: Catálogo para redes shows the switch (off by default), the address /api/feeds/tiendas/<slug> and the steps for Meta Commerce Manager
steps: Open Mi tienda → Catálogo para redes; turn it on

requirement: The store feed lists only public publications with price and photo
expected: Approved publications of the store with a price and a photo appear; sold, hidden or Admin-paused ones do not; zero stock shows "out of stock"
preconditions: Feed on; publications in each state

requirement: A store feed that is off or of an inactive store does not exist
expected: The feed answers 404 while off or when the store is not active
preconditions: Feed off; then a suspended store

requirement: Feed prices and stock follow the publication
expected: After a price change the next fetch (after the one-hour cache) shows the new price

requirement: Laria's feed is served only in production
expected: /api/feeds/laria answers 404 on previews and local builds that are not indexable

requirement: robots.txt lets platforms read the feeds
expected: robots.txt allows /api/feeds/ while keeping other /api/ paths disallowed

requirement: Feed XML is valid and escaped
expected: Titles with &, < and control characters produce valid XML; descriptions stop at 5,000 characters

requirement: A store sends a brand authorization for review
expected: The store uploads a PDF or image up to 5 MB to the issued path; the server checks the bytes; Admin sees the request
steps: Open Mi tienda → Distribuidor oficial; send a document

requirement: Only the owner can upload to the issued path, once
expected: Another path, another owner, or a second upload is refused by storage policy; the table is not readable through the API

requirement: A file that is not a real PDF or image never reaches Admin
expected: A renamed executable or a mismatched type is refused at completion

requirement: Admin approves, rejects or revokes with a reason, audited
expected: Each decision needs the current revision, rejection and revocation need a reason, the owner gets an in-app notification and the audit log records it

requirement: The mark shows only on new publications of the approved brand and store
expected: Distribuidor oficial <marca> appears on the store's new publications of that brand while in force; not on used ones, other brands or other sellers
steps: Open a new and a used publication

requirement: The mark says what Laria checked and what it did not
expected: Qué revisó Laria says Laria read a document, not each instrument or the warranty
steps: Open the mark on a publication

requirement: An expired authorization stops showing without Admin action
expected: The day after valid_until (Lima), the mark and the store page brand disappear

requirement: The store page and the brand filter name the dealers
expected: The store page lists its dealer brands; the catalog filtered by a brand names that brand's dealers

requirement: Admin creates a dated campaign page
expected: A campaign has a name, address, dates of at most 30 days and a minimum discount of 5 to 70 %; changes need the current revision and are audited

requirement: Laria checks the reference price against 30 days of history
expected: A publication joins only if its current price is the lowest of the 30 days before and the campaign price is at least the minimum discount below it

requirement: A price raised within the 30 days cannot be an "Antes"
expected: Joining is refused with CAMPAIGN_PRICE_RAISED and the store sees the lowest price of the period
preconditions: Publication whose price went up in the last 30 days

requirement: A publication with less than 30 days of history cannot join
expected: Joining is refused with CAMPAIGN_HISTORY_SHORT and the date it can join

requirement: The store must choose what happens after the campaign
expected: Neither option is preselected; joining without a choice is refused

requirement: The job applies the campaign price at the start and restores it at the end when asked
expected: At the start the publication shows the campaign price; at the end it returns to the earlier price only with "Volver al precio anterior"

requirement: A price change by the store takes the publication out
expected: The entry ends and the publication keeps the store's new price and leaves the campaign page

requirement: Campaign pages show dates, never countdowns
expected: Pages and marks show "Del … al …" and "hasta el …"; no timers, no "últimas horas"

requirement: The publication shows its campaign with what Laria checked
expected: En <campaña>: N % menos, hasta el … with the checked lowest price of 30 days

requirement: Admin can remove an entry with a reason
expected: The entry ends, the price is restored if the store asked for it, the store is notified, and the action is audited

requirement: Price history stays consistent under concurrent edits
expected: Two concurrent price changes never leave a period that ends before it starts

requirement: Only current campaign pages are indexed
expected: An ended or upcoming campaign page and page 2+ are noindex
steps: Open the pages and read robots meta

requirement: A store connects Mercado Libre and imports chosen publications
expected: After OAuth, the store sees its active publications 50 at a time, picks up to 100 with nothing preselected, and the import wizard opens with them
preconditions: ML test app and account; env set
steps: Open Mi tienda → Importar desde Mercado Libre

requirement: The import is off without credentials
expected: Without the three MERCADOLIBRE_* variables, the routes answer 503 and the page links to the Excel import

requirement: The OAuth flow is bound to the user and the request
expected: State and PKCE verifier travel in a signed, httpOnly cookie for 10 minutes; a callback with another user, an altered state or no cookie is refused

requirement: Tokens are encrypted and never readable through the API
expected: Tokens are stored AES-256-GCM encrypted with the store id as associated data; owner and anonymous roles cannot read them; only service-role functions return them

requirement: Only the account's own publications are imported
expected: Publications of another seller returned by the API are dropped
preconditions: Fake API with a foreign item

requirement: Mapping leaves for review what Laria cannot know
expected: USD prices and used conditions are empty, prices are whole soles, one row per variation, unique SKUs

requirement: Photos come only from Mercado Libre's image hosts and pass the photo check
expected: Only https *.mlstatic.com URLs are fetched, without redirects, up to 5 MB; each is checked like an uploaded photo and matched to its SKU and order

requirement: Disconnecting deletes the tokens
expected: After Desconectar, no token remains and the page says to remove Laria in Mercado Libre too

requirement: Imported publications follow the usual moderation and allowance
expected: Publishing from the import uses the existing review and listing allowance

requirement: Every page of the batch is reachable from Mi tienda
expected: Más alcance para tu tienda links the five pages for active and pending stores; the account menu is unchanged

requirement: The batch's pages pass the accessibility checks
expected: axe (WCAG 2.0–2.2 A and AA) finds no violations at 390 and 1366 px

requirement: Laria never handles money or implies it guarantees deals
expected: No page of the batch says Laria holds payments, verifies instruments or guarantees prices beyond what it checked
